name: Angelita Morillo

bio.statement: The City of Portland says Morillo was elected District 3 city councilor in November 2024 and began her term in January 2025.
bio.excerpt: Elected as City Councilor for District 3 in November 2024 and began their term of office in January 2025.

verification.note: Excerpt confirmed verbatim in the councilor's City of Portland page, re-fetched 2026-10-14. Attribution, tier, paraphrase and neutrality checked. The page says 'their term'; Morillo's page lists her pronouns as She/They, so 'her' is used.

bio.statement: On her City of Portland page, Morillo describes herself as a Paraguayan immigrant and Portlander who has experienced homelessness.
bio.excerpt: As a Paraguayan immigrant and Portlander who has experienced homelessness here

verification.note: The passage is written in the first person ('As a Paraguayan immigrant ... I know'), so the statement now presents it as her own description. Morillo's page lists her pronouns as She/They, so 'her' is used. Re-fetched 2026-10-14.

verification_summary.balance_notes: Race portland-council-d3 (21 candidates). Every candidate was searched in the same shared sources: the Mercury (2026-09-09), OPB (2026-10-07), the Tribune Q&A (2026-10-13), the Multnomah pamphlet and the 2026 AUD-120 forms. Morillo has 5 bio and 9 position items (T1 council page and pamphlet, T3). The AUD-120 has no readable text. One statement was corrected. Her pronouns are She/They (council page). The website angelitaforportland.com is printed in the pamphlet. Incumbent=true confirmed. A Willamette Week article dated 2026-01-07 was not used.
